# MAN — Personal AI Intelligence Agent

## About
MAN is a personal AI intelligence and assistant system created by MD Rayhan Mia, a developer and AI agent builder based in Rangpur, Bangladesh. MAN provides natural AI conversation, persistent memory, voice support, multi-user isolation, and human-in-the-loop approval.

## Company / Creator
- Name: MD Rayhan Mia
- Location: Rangpur, Bangladesh
- Role: Developer & AI agent builder
- Ecosystem: MAA (Master AI Architect) — a reusable methodology for reliable AI products

## Key pages
- https://ai-concierge-lake-three.vercel.app — MAN web app (login & chat)
- https://ai-concierge-lake-three.vercel.app/about — About MAN & MD Rayhan Mia
- https://github.com/alvidrishti/ai-concierge — MAN source code

## What MAN does
- AI chat with Gemini → Groq → OpenRouter → GitHub fallback
- Persistent per-user memory (Supabase)
- Voice input & output
- Multi-user authentication & isolation
- Human-in-the-loop approval gate for consequential actions
- Bangla (Bengali) language support

## Actions available
- Chat with the AI assistant
- Voice interaction
- Login / social sign-in (Google, GitHub, Facebook)

- GitHub: https://github.com/alvidrishti
